directive: Audit first; consolidate existing economy systems; do not duplicate energy, currencies, rewards, shop, purchases, or battle pass.

findings.existing: No standalone production energy system found; only generic energy terms in lore/art and one runtime mention. Add one authoritative energy wallet under central economy state.
No authoritative GOLD resource found; existing runtime resources are Gate Shards, Ascension Ember, Deity Relics, Raid Tokens, Signature Alloy, Mastery Seals, Trial Favor.
Existing monetization-policy mentions premium progression and command-hub has premium currency language, but no authoritative wallet/product ledger.
Gate Shards exist in command hub runtime and rewards. Deity unlock shard concept exists but was not centralized.
Progression/onboarding supports unlock concepts and Trial previews. deities are not payment locked.
Deity Relics, Signature Alloy, mastery, trial gear, and upgrade philosophy exist.
Reward cache and reward-system exist; command runtime grants shards/relics/xp.
No standalone daily reward system found.
Season/event support exists in season-system and weekly trials.
Async arena shop rotation and monetization policy references exist; no authoritative shop catalog.
No ad provider configured; command contracts mention ads as possible rewards.
No payment provider configured; no real purchase integration.
season-system has season template with free/premium concepts but no full reward ladder.
Cooldowns exist for combat abilities; no economy regen config.

migrationRules: Preserve existing player resources and append missing core wallets instead of wiping saves.
Map MG-RES-GATE-SHARDS to SHARDS in economy views while preserving legacy id compatibility.
Do not expose development test purchases in production mode.
All premium purchases require server verification before grant.
Combat, campaign, divine trials, raids, and async arena remain playable without purchase.
